+# Formal LSTM Feature-Ablation Production Assurance
+
+## Baseline
+
+Verified at `HEAD` `cc59d54` (`Add causal directional adverse excursion feature`).  The
+pre-existing worktree changes were limited to the stated formal feature-ablation
+increment; no unrelated source increment was present.  The baseline invariants
+remain true:
+
+- `feature_size` remains 45 and current `n_in` remains 49.
+- Ablation does not change the feature semantic version, physical Tensor layout,
+  or historical model-input-width mappings.
+- Projection occurs before masking; the shared helper zeroes only selected
+  projected Tensor feature positions, retains width, and does not mutate source
+  Tensor state/history.  A mask for a feature absent from a historical prefix
+  fails closed.  Return features remain outside this mechanism.
+
+The active scheduler discovered during the safety check belonged to the separate
+`/Volumes/Developer SSD/ExpertAdvisor` worktree (PIDs 78046/78095).  No worker,
+scheduler, or production experiment row was touched.
+
+## Files inspected
+
+- `Headers/FeatureAblation.hpp`
+- `Headers/ModelInputContract.hpp`, `Headers/LSTM.hpp`
+- `LSTM/LSTM.cpp`, `LSTM/main.cpp`
+- `Sources/ExperimentScheduler.cpp`
+- `Sources/ExperimentRecommendation.cpp`, `Sources/ExperimentRecommendationConversionWorkflow.cpp`
+- `Sources/CampaignPlanning.cpp`, `Sources/CampaignMaterialization.cpp`,
+  `Sources/CampaignOutcomeAssessment.cpp`, `Sources/ContinuationPolicy.cpp`
+- `Database/migrations/051_scheduler_ownership_and_worker_attempts.sql`,
+  `052_scheduler_protocol_and_exact_attempt_hardening.sql`,
+  `069_feature_ablation_mask.sql`
+- The focused compatibility, recommendation/campaign, continuation, retry, and
+  migration tests named below.
+
+## Files changed in this correction pass
+
+- `LSTM/main.cpp`: loads the mask from model/experiment provenance and compares
+  it with the scheduler experiment (or checkpoint-evaluation parent) before
+  materializing model input.  A mismatch throws
+  `FEATURE_ABLATION_MASK_LINEAGE_MISMATCH`.
+- `Sources/ExperimentScheduler.cpp`: propagates the canonical mask through real
+  `ExperimentRow`, resume compatibility, retry checkpoint selection,
+  continuation validation, and concise metadata/status output.
+- `Database/migrations/069_feature_ablation_mask.sql`: grants the established
+  `pqxx` role the experiment-table privileges after adding the column/index.
+- `Database/migrations/070_model_experiment_lineage_immutable.sql`: prevents a
+  non-null `model.experiment_id` from being removed or redirected.  It permits
+  the existing first-link handoff from legacy NULL rows, so no duplicate model
+  mask column is needed.
+- `Tests/LSTMModelInputCompatibilityTests.cpp`: adds complete deterministic
+  canonical-order coverage.
+- `Tests/SchedulerRetryFailedCheckpointPromotionIntegrationTests.sh`: applies
+  migrations 069/070 and asserts that retry retains a non-empty canonical mask.
+- `Tests/FeatureAblationMigrationTests.sql`: verifies column/default/index/grant
+  contract.
+
+## Queue and database round-trip
+
+The registry accepts canonical names, trims and deduplicates input, sorts by
+Tensor column, rejects unknown/empty tokens, and emits canonical text.  The
+queue parser persists exactly that text, includes it in duplicate lookup and the
+unique identity, and reloads it through `ExperimentRow`.  Empty/default queues
+persist `''`.  Thus differently ordered logical masks identify the same row;
+different masks identify different rows.
+
+The SQL/migration portion was exercised on a disposable cloned database.  A
+full executable queue round-trip could not be run because the local Debug binary
+cannot link (`ld: library 'MetalBuffer' not found`); see gaps below.
+
+## Migration 069
+
+PASS.  On a disposable schema clone, migration 069 applied twice successfully.
+It creates `experiment.feature_ablation_mask text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`, so
+existing rows receive no ablation.  It recreates
+`experiment_unique_identity_uidx` with the existing identity dimensions plus
+`donchian20_mode`, `donchian_lookback`, `feature_warmup_scope`, and
+`feature_ablation_mask`; it does not remove prior dimensions.  The `pqxx` role
+retains SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE access to `experiment`.
+
+## Resume-loader coverage map
+
+| Entry path | Persisted source | Result |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `--resume-model-id` | `model.experiment_id -> experiment.feature_ablation_mask` | Loaded by `LoadResumeCheckpointConfig`; historical NULL lineage resolves to empty mask. |
+| scheduled training resume | source model plus `scheduler_experiment_id` | Both canonical masks are compared before Tensor/model construction. |
+| normal final inference | model experiment lineage | Loaded by `LoadPersistedInferenceConfig`; not CLI/default state. |
+| infer-all | each candidate model lineage | Each model receives its own persisted canonical mask. |
+| checkpoint inference | checkpoint model lineage plus checkpoint-evaluation parent experiment | Existing ownership check is retained; new mask equality check runs before input construction. |
+| automatic/manual continuation | source experiment plus selected source model | Child inherits source mask and validation rejects unequal model lineage. |
+
+Matching persisted masks proceed; unequal canonical masks fail closed with
+`FEATURE_ABLATION_MASK_LINEAGE_MISMATCH`.  Legacy model rows without an
+`experiment_id` deliberately resolve to no ablation.  This comparison is
+executed before training/inference consumes model input.  The code path was
+syntax-compiled, but an end-to-end executable matching/mismatch test remains
+blocked by the local linker issue.
+
+## Retry, checkpoint inference, and normal inference
+
+Retry keeps the original experiment row and its exact canonical mask.  Candidate
+checkpoint selection now loads the candidate model lineage mask and rejects it
+when it differs; it cannot reset the target mask to `''` or substitute another
+mask.  The maintained retry integration test now contains a masked target and
+an assertion that the mask remains `return_sign_persistence` after retry.
+
+Checkpoint evaluation already requires the checkpoint model to belong to the
+parent experiment.  The worker now also compares the model's persisted mask with
+that parent experiment's mask.  Final/normal inference and infer-all source the
+mask from `model.experiment_id`, use the same shared projection/mask helper as
+training, and do not accept a CLI-global substitute.
+
+## Model provenance, continuation, and campaigns
+
+`model.experiment_id` is sufficient ablation provenance once immutable: the
+experiment row owns the canonical mask and migration 070 prevents a linked model
+from being silently retargeted.  No redundant model-mask column was added.
+
+Continuation reads the source experiment's canonical mask into the child and
+compares it with the selected model lineage first.  Ordinary recommendation
+conversion intentionally omits this optional field and therefore receives the
+database default `''`; there is no feature-semantic version bump.  Campaign and
+outcome evidence retains experiment identity, so distinct masked/unmasked
+experiments cannot collapse merely because other configuration values match.
+
+## Operator visibility
+
+Maintained experiment metadata/status output now includes concise
+`feature_ablation_mask=<canonical-mask>`.
+

+The required Release command was attempted exactly as specified with

+std::string LoadModelFeatureAblationMask(pqxx::work& w, long long modelId)
+{
+    const pqxx::result rows = w.exec_params(
+        "SELECT m.experiment_id,e.feature_ablation_mask FROM model m "
+        "LEFT JOIN experiment e ON e.experiment_id=m.experiment_id "
+        "WHERE m.model_id=$1;",
+        modelId);
+    if (rows.empty())
+        throw std::runtime_error("resume model_id not found");
+    // A model without experiment provenance predates formal ablation and is
+    // intentionally interpreted as the historical no-ablation contract.
+    if (rows[0][0].is_null()) return {};
+    if (rows[0][1].is_null())
+        throw std::runtime_error("resume_model_feature_ablation_lineage_missing");
+    return EA::FeatureAblationMask::Parse(rows[0][1].as<std::string>()).CanonicalText();
+}

+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    identity_index text;
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+        WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='experiment'
+          AND column_name='feature_ablation_mask'
+          AND data_type='text' AND is_nullable='NO'
+          AND column_default=$default$''::text$default$
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature_ablation_mask must be text NOT NULL DEFAULT empty';
+    END IF;
+    IF EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM experiment WHERE feature_ablation_mask <> ''
+    ) AND NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM experiment WHERE feature_ablation_mask = ''
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'migration did not retain a no-ablation compatibility default';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT pg_get_indexdef(indexrelid) INTO identity_index
+    FROM pg_index
+    WHERE indexrelid='experiment_unique_identity_uidx'::regclass;
+    IF identity_index IS NULL OR
+       identity_index NOT LIKE '%donchian20_mode%' OR
+       identity_index NOT LIKE '%feature_warmup_scope%' OR
+       identity_index NOT LIKE '%donchian_lookback%' OR
+       identity_index NOT LIKE '%feature_ablation_mask%' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'experiment identity index is missing persisted configuration fields: %', identity_index;
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT has_table_privilege('pqxx', 'experiment', 'SELECT') OR
+       NOT has_table_privilege('pqxx', 'experiment', 'INSERT') OR
+       NOT has_table_privilege('pqxx', 'experiment', 'UPDATE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'pqxx experiment role grants are insufficient';
+    END IF;
+END $$;
